title: The Red Spider Nebula, caught by Webb
caption: The Red Spider Nebula, NGC 6537, imaged by the James Webb Space Telescope
credit: ESA/Webb, NASA & CSA, J. H. Kastner (Rochester Institute of Technology)

recognition.text: Ranked #3 on ESA/Webb’s published “Top 100 Images” list (an institutional selection, not an audience score).

story: Two large loops of blue molecular gas stretch diagonally away from a blotchy pinkish center, where strong red light illuminates the dust, all set against thousands of whitish stars. This is NGC 6537, the Red Spider Nebula, a planetary nebula seen in new detail by Webb.

Planetary nebulae form when Sun-like stars die. After swelling into red giants, they shed their outer layers, exposing white-hot cores whose ultraviolet light makes the cast-off gas glow. This stage lasts only a few tens of thousands of years.

Webb revealed the full extent of the spider's legs for the first time. They are closed bubbles, each about 3 light-years long, traced by glowing hydrogen molecules. The central star, faint and blue in Hubble's view, shows up red here because Webb detected hot dust around it, probably orbiting in a disc. A hidden companion star may explain the narrow waist and wide lobes.

understand.summary: This is a near-infrared image from Webb's NIRCam. Light from iron is shown in blue, molecular hydrogen in cyan, a 3.56-micron filter in orange and hydrogen's Brackett-alpha line in red.
understand.eye: This infrared light is invisible to the eye, which is why the central star, faint and blue in visible light, can appear red here.

explore: A purple S shape through the center traces glowing iron atoms, marking where a fast jet from near the central star has crashed into material the star shed earlier, sculpting the rippling structure.
The observations belong to a joint Chandra and Webb program studying how outflows and jets shape bipolar planetary nebulae.
alt: A planetary nebula with a blotchy pinkish center glowing red, two large blue loops extending diagonally to the corners, and many whitish background stars.
